dct_description_sm:
The Big Game Management Areas feature layer is maintained by the Wildlife Division and serves as a centralized dataset for big game management area boundaries within Newfoundland and Labrador.

The dataset includes Moose Management Areas, Caribou Management Areas, and Black Bear Management Areas. These layers define the geographic zones used for population monitoring, hunting regulations, and resource planning.

Expanding the layers below provides further information pertinent to each dataset.

This authoritative dataset is intended for use in wildlife management, regulatory enforcement, and spatial analysis to support sustainable resource management across the province.
